newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for May 13.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for May 13.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open on Tuesday to larger ships, despite storms expected in the northern Gulf of Mexico, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1500 GMT daily meteorological report.
Ports were closed to smaller fishing and tourism ships at Tampico, Veracruz, El Mezquital, Nautla and Tuxpan. The bulletin said that expectations of strong northern winds prompted the closures.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.

Clear skies and winds along the northern coast from 15 to 20 knots (28 to 38 km/16 to 22 miles per hour) and waves four to six feet high. Winds calmer along the rest of the coast and light rains along Sinaloa, Jalisco, Michoacan, Oaxaca and Chiapas states.
Some clouds and rains expected along coasts of Tamaulipas and Veracruz states. Maximum winds from 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) and waves three to five feet high.
Hot and partly cloudy with winds from 20 to 30 km per hour. More clouds and rains expected later in the day.
